news.title: Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju Starrer Bethlehem Kudumba Unit Locks OTT Date
news.summary: The Malayalam romantic comedy drama Bethlehem Kudumba Unit is heading to digital platforms following its successful theatrical run. Directed by Girish A.D., the film features Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju in the lead roles alongside an ensemble cast. Viewers can stream the movie on JioHotstar starting October 2.

news.title: Suriya Advises Admirers to Ignore Digital Trolls and Focus on Work
news.summary: Tamil actor Suriya recently interacted with his fan club members and urged them to steer clear of online negativity and controversies. He advised them not to waste their energy on critics, emphasizing that spreading love and focusing on daily efforts will naturally lead to success.

news.title: Can Rajinikanth's Sequel Hit the Milestone Despite Muted Buzz?
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's highly anticipated sequel, Jailer 2, is carrying massive pre-release business expectations and a hefty worldwide target. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the film aims for an October 15 release, though its promotional campaign and recent singles have yet to match the hype of the original blockbuster.

news.title: Rajinikanth's Dharman Eyeing a Grand Pongal 2027 Arrival
news.summary: Rajinikanth's 173rd feature, Dharman, is gearing up for a major theatrical release during the Pongal 2027 festival window. Directed by Ashwath Marimuthu and backed by Kamal Haasan's Raaj Kamal Films International, the action thriller also features Ram Pothineni in a significant role.

news.title: Mahesh Babu's Post-Varanasi Venture Sparks Speculation
news.summary: Mahesh Babu is nearing the completion of his portions for SS Rajamouli's Varanasi, which features Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Prithviraj Sukumaran and is slated for an April 7, 2027 release. As the superstar wraps up his dubbing work, discussions regarding his next collaboration have intensified across the industry. While names like Lokesh Kanagaraj have entered fan conversations following mutual praise and a new banner alliance, no official actor-director pairing has been confirmed yet.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Address Backlash Over The Paradise Dialogue
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela opened up about the audience criticism surrounding a specific line in their recent box-office hit, The Paradise. The makers explained that a crucial childhood backstory was edited out for runtime, which caused the heroine's mother calling Kayadu Lohar's character a single-take artist to feel abrupt and ironic to viewers. Despite this minor narrative hiccup, the Sudhakar Cherukuri-produced drama is racing toward the Rs. 150 crore gross milestone.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Flaunts Vintage Style in Fresh Photoshoot
news.summary: Taapsee Pannu recently showcased a striking retro glamour look featuring voluminous curls and a floral mini dress against a vintage bathroom backdrop. The actor, who has previously navigated challenges regarding early career hurdles, continues to focus selectively on meaningful roles. Professionally, while her recent cinematic outings underperformed, she is currently busy filming for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan? where she plays ACP Komal Sharma.

news.title: NTR Set to Restart Dragon Filming in Mumbai
news.summary: Following a recovery break due to a shoulder injury, actor NTR is preparing to return to the sets for Prashanth Neel's directorial venture, Dragon. A high-voltage action schedule is lined up in Mumbai starting October 10th, featuring a two-week stunt sequence. Co-starring Rukmini Vasanth, Anil Kapoor, and Biju Menon, the big-budget actioner backed by Mythri Movie Makers and NTR Arts aims to wrap its remaining schedules by the end of the year.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi's January 12 Vidudala Nearing Completion
news.summary: Filmmaker Anil Ravipudi is wrapping up the final schedule of his upcoming directorial venture titled January 12 Vidudala. The movie features Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty in lead roles. The production team plans to finish all filming by mid-November, leaving ample time for post-production ahead of the January 12 theatrical release.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Strong Box Office Momentum
news.summary: Actor Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, is witnessing steady and impressive ticket sales following a record-breaking opening. Directed by Srikanth Odela and produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri, the film drew massive family crowds to cinema halls over the weekend holiday. The consistent box office numbers highlight the strong audience appeal and star power of the lead actor.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Unveiled Ahead of October Release
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for the romantic musical entertainer Chakkora has been launched, setting the stage for its worldwide theatrical release on October 9. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the movie follows a carefree young man whose life changes dramatically after falling in love and facing a mysterious disappearance. The film features Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal in pivotal roles alongside music composed by Prince Henry.

news.title: Makers of Ramayana Reveal Fresh Posters Featuring Lead Cast
news.summary: The upcoming mythological epic Ramayana, directed by Nitesh Tiwari, has unveiled new promotional stills showcasing Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey. Another newly released poster gives a first look at Yash portraying the antagonist Ravana with a regal and commanding presence. Backed by Prime Focus Studios and other production houses, Part 1 of the project is slated for a Diwali 2026 release.

news.title: Aakash Jagannadh unveils Chakkora trailer blending romance and mystery
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird was launched in Hyderabad by Aakash Jagannadh. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the movie features Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal in lead roles. Backed by High Joy Commercials and Vintage Iconic Pictures, the film is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: Nani starrer The Paradise maintains strong box office momentum over opening weekend
news.summary: Nani's latest movie The Paradise opened to solid numbers despite mixed initial reviews from critics. Makers reported a worldwide gross of 136 crore rupees in its first three days, supported by strong bookings in the Telugu states and overseas markets. The team recently celebrated the film's success at an event joined by actor Mohan Babu.

news.title: NTR prepares to return to action for upcoming schedule of Dragon
news.summary: Actor NTR is set to resume shooting for his pan-India project Dragon after recovering from a shoulder injury and surgery. The next 15-day schedule starts on October 10 in Mumbai and will feature high-octane action sequences involving NTR and Anil Kapoor. Directed by Prashanth Neel and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the film is currently slated for a June 2027 release.

news.title: Box office endurance of The Paradise faces crucial weekday assessment
news.summary: Nani's big-budget venture The Paradise enters a critical phase at the box office after generating impressive numbers during its opening weekend. While trade reports estimated strong collections reaching close to 150 crore rupees by the weekend, the film still faces a significant target to break even across multiple territories. The absence of major competing releases next week could provide a steady window for the film to sustain its run.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Unveiled for Epic Ramayana Film
news.summary: The creators of the grand adaptation Ramayana have released two striking new character previews, highlighting Yash in a powerful avatar as Ravana alongside the main trio. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by producer Namit Malhotra, the film features music by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. The ambitious cinematic project is scheduled for a two-part release during the Diwali seasons of 2026 and 2027.

news.title: Tabu Set for Special Character Teaser in Nagarjuna Milestone Film King100
news.summary: The production team behind Nagarjuna Akkineni's milestone project King100 is preparing to launch a promotional video spotlighting Tabu's character. Marking a nostalgic on-screen reunion for the iconic 1990s pair, the movie also stars Sushmita Bhat among its three female leads. Directed by Ra Karthik with music by Devi Sri Prasad, the feature is slated for theatrical release on December 24, 2026.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda Starrer Ranabaali Launching Four-Part Promotional Docu-Series
news.summary: The team behind the historical drama Ranabaali is rolling out a four-part documentary series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget, with the first episode premiering on social media. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the project reflects two years of research into Rayalaseema history. The film stars Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, and is set to arrive in cinemas on October 16, 2026.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Steady Box Office Numbers in Nizam on Day Three
news.summary: The action drama The Paradise sustained a solid commercial run in the Nizam region on its third day, nearly matching its previous day's collections. Directed by Srikanth Odela and produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri, the movie features a strong ensemble cast including Mohan Babu and Kayadu Lohar. Industry trackers are closely watching Sunday's figures to gauge the overall weekend trajectory for the theatrical release.

news.title: KTR Applauds Nani and Srikanth Odela's The Paradise After Hyderabad Screening
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR watched the Nani-starrer The Paradise at Sudarshan Theatre in Hyderabad. He praised the film for authentically showcasing Telangana's culture, language, and the struggles of an oppressed community. He congratulated the entire team, including hero Nani and director Srikanth Odela, for delivering a compelling cinematic experience.

news.title: Industry Buzz Puts Rashmika Mandanna Ahead of Sai Pallavi in OTT Valuation
news.summary: Reports indicate that digital streaming platforms are offering higher financial value for female-centric projects led by Rashmika Mandanna compared to those starring Sai Pallavi. Industry insiders attribute this difference to Rashmika's involvement in major pan-Indian blockbusters and her vast social media following. Her recent casting in the MS Subbulakshmi biopic further highlights her growing digital market strength.

news.title: The Paradise Maintains Strong BookMyShow Momentum on Day Three
news.summary: Despite receiving mixed audience reactions, the Nani-starrer The Paradise maintained steady ticket sales on BookMyShow during its third day. The film recorded 252K ticket sales, nearly matching its second-day numbers. Backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri and directed by Srikanth Odela, the movie crossed Rs. 115 crore in gross earnings over its first two days.

news.title: Bigg Boss Telugu Wildcard Contestant Mithilesh Exits House With Cash Prize
news.summary: In a surprising turn of events on Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, wildcard contestant Mithilesh accepted a Rs. 15 lakh temptation offer from the makers and chose to exit the house. Having entered just a day prior, he decided to walk away with the substantial cash sum, reasoning that he could not alter the dynamics or win the title. This quick departure marks an unprecedented moment in the reality show's history.
